title: package docs (ADR-0046): allow images in in-app help manuals — v1 refuses every image (docs/no-images)
body: ## What we need An app package's in-app help manuals (package docs, ADR-0046) cannot carry a single image on 18.6.0. `collect-docs` rejects any `[..](..)` or `` in a doc body with `docs/no-images`, and `os build` fails: ``` Doc "crm_cb_rep_chapters" (zh) contains an image reference — not allowed in v1 (ADR-0046 §3.4) ``` The same check is on main. ADR-0046 defers images to v2, the "platform asset service". ## Why it matters We are delivering a vertical CRM to a client, with the user manuals as role-based in-app help books, as ADR-0046 intends. The client's acceptance asks for operating steps with screenshots. Today the only places for screenshots are outside the app: the public docs site, or files kept beside the manual. That splits each manual in two and would put a private customer's manual on a public site. ## Ask - Let a package's docs carry images: files shipped in the package (for example `docs/assets/…`), referenced by relative path, served under the same access as the doc. Doc access is already scoped by the book's audience, so a role-scoped manual's screenshots should not be public. - Until v2 lands, keep the `docs/no-images` refusal as it is: it is clear, and we are not working around it. - If v2 has a rough timeline, a note here helps us plan the client's acceptance. Version: @objectstack/* 18.6.0. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
